intro: The detective has vanished, leaving only a violin with one string retuned and a stack of notes addressed to whoever is clever enough to read them.
echo: It is always the person you trusted with the tea.

puzzles.title: Elementary
puzzles.flavor: Every part described by its first two stripes, and nothing else.

partials.13542b63ef1ae1ce6bdee3f6670e9ae42b1c0eae: Nearly. There's a stowaway aboard: one letter too many. Put it ashore, but remember who it was.

hints: Where would you see stripes like these, and what do engineers read them as?
Each colour stands for a digit.

puzzles.title: Five Orange Pips
puzzles.flavor: An inventory of Baker Street, tangled up. Whatever is left over when every item is accounted for is yours.

blocks.text: Hidden in the grid: 6 words to do with Baker Street.

partials.1011b92859f50d921a0d859b9dc8d987344f08bf: Nearly. There's a stowaway aboard: one letter too many. Put it ashore, but remember who it was.

hints: Once everything that belongs here is accounted for, is anything left unclaimed?
Find the theme words; the letters no word uses are the ones that matter.
The hidden words are: BUTLER, HANSOM, LEDGER, MANOR, POISON, WITNESS.

puzzles.title: The Final Problem
puzzles.flavor: Someone wrote this out in a zigzag across three lines of the ledger, then copied each line out in turn.

blocks.text: NDPEY TTSSE ZJOOO RTOOY XETDN OEOET IFROH PIESU TNWRC NEVAO YBECA NGHAT RISED SLR

partials.389ecdb593d9ad1f6641987a63a641725056b50f: Nearly. There's a stowaway aboard: one letter too many. Put it ashore, but remember who it was.

hints: All the right letters seem to be here, just out of order. Could they have been written along some path?
Written in a zigzag over a few rows, then copied out row by row.

puzzles.title: The Speckled Band
puzzles.flavor: The labels at Baker Street have faded. Each one lost exactly one letter.

partials.4735f45c583d7835f079c1824032b3044ffdbbd3: Nearly. There's a stowaway aboard: one letter too many. Put it ashore, but remember who it was.

hints: What fills each gap? Is there a pattern in what you filled in?
Collect the letters you had to supply.

puzzles.title: Dancing Men
puzzles.flavor: A strip of paper tape, seven holes wide, fed through the teletype at Baker Street.

partials.e99848e2ee945671695ac69123cd04ee0761886d: Nearly. There's a stowaway aboard: one letter too many. Put it ashore, but remember who it was.

hints: Seven positions a row, each punched or not. What were seven bits once enough for?
Teletype tape carried a standard character code.

puzzles.title: The Dog In The Night
puzzles.flavor: The typist at Baker Street was consistently, reliably, one step off. Whatever you find, it was said on the way out, not the way in.

partials.f696fa55a935a7a83343186ee9e1f6ac78a2be9b: You've decoded it, but it's not finished. One more layer.
partials.58adb69886025915d0a6a18762f01b0ffbff279f: Nearly. There's a stowaway aboard: one letter too many. Put it ashore, but remember who it was.

hints: Try typing this. Where are your fingers?
Look at the keyboard in front of you, and at each key's neighbours. Whatever you get may still need one more twist.

puzzles.title: The Empty House
puzzles.flavor: Confetti, sorted alphabetically by a very tidy intern. Put it back together.

partials.ab68e9ad50cac3573f378bec562d6aaffeb3f007: Nearly. There's a stowaway aboard: one letter too many. Put it ashore, but remember who it was.

hints: The pieces are all here, just shuffled. What order would make sense of them?
Use the word lengths to rebuild the sentence.

meta.title: Meta: 221B, Upstairs
meta.flavor: Everything arrived a little heavier than it left.
hints: Did every answer come out the right size the first time? What did you have to throw overboard?
Each feeder decoded with one letter too many. Those letters matter.
